You have attempted this same task before and did not succeed. These are the plans you wrote after those attempts.
Trial #1: New plan: I failed because I did not track the location of objects I picked up, leading to attempts to put items on shelves or tables in rooms where they were not visible. I also ignored the inventory limit, trying to hold more than two items. The correct strategy is: 1) Before picking up an item, verify its current location and destination. 2) Only pick up items if my inventory has space (max 2). 3) Always move to the specific room containing the target object (e.g., go to the kitchen to put the sandwich on the table, go to the living room to put the book on the shelf, go to the pantry to put the mop in the cupboard) before attempting to place it. 4) Do not attempt to put an item on a surface unless I am currently in the room where that surface exists.

Trial #2: New plan: I failed because I became stuck in an infinite loop of moving back and forth between the kitchen and living room after successfully retrieving the sandwich, instead of proceeding to place it or retrieve the next item. I did not check if I had already completed the task for the sandwich or if I was in the correct room to place it. The correct strategy is: 1) After retrieving an item, immediately verify the current room and the target location for that item. 2) If the item is retrieved, move directly to the room where the target surface (side table, shelf, or cupboard) is located. 3) Only move between rooms if necessary to reach the target location, avoiding redundant back-and-forth travel. 4) Once an item is placed, confirm the task is complete before moving to the next item.

New plan: I failed because I repeatedly attempted to take the book from the living room without first verifying its actual location, and I ignored the instruction to place the mop in the cupboard (which I never retrieved or moved). I also failed to check the inventory limit before picking up the sandwich, resulting in a full inventory that prevented me from taking the book. The correct strategy is: 1) Before taking any item, explicitly check the room description to confirm the item's presence. 2) Before picking up a new item, verify that the inventory contains fewer than 2 items. 3) Retrieve the mop from the kitchen cupboard first, then move it to the kitchen cupboard (or wherever the goal specifies for the mop, re-reading the goal: "mop in the cupboard"). 4) Retrieve the book from the kitchen cupboard (since it wasn't in the living room), then move it to the living room shelf. 5) Retrieve the sandwich from the pantry refrigerator, then move it to the living room side table. 6) Only execute the final "> done" after all three items are confirmed in their target locations.
